verdict.rationale: Sierra explicitly advertises a testing capability ('Verify your agent performs as expected across a wide range of scenarios and avoid regressions') and a release-governance blog describing 'Agent Checks and Simulations catching problems proactively' plus staged rollout via split traffic, directly matching pre-production testing/QA. Sierra also created tau-bench, a benchmark for simulating dynamic user-agent conversations, reinforcing its simulation-testing focus. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of testing against real/historical ticket transcripts (only simulated conversations are described) and independent/hands-on validation of simulation accuracy.
